# Kepty Co., Ltd.

> Japan market-entry partner for overseas sport, fitness, recovery and wellness brands.

Kepty Co., Ltd. (株式会社Kepty) helps companies based outside Japan sell sport, fitness and recovery products in Japan. The company also runs Kepty English, an English-learning service for professional, youth and academy footballers. That football network is the commercial core of the market-entry work.

## Facts

- English name: Kepty Co., Ltd.
- Japanese name: 株式会社Kepty
- Brand: KEPTY
- Founder & CEO: Tomohiro Kajiyama (梶山 知裕)
- Contact: contact@kepty.co
- Market served: Japan
- Clients: overseas brands (sport, fitness, recovery)
- Reporting language to overseas headquarters: English

## What we do

- Japan market entry and sales support for overseas brands
- Online sales: dedicated websites, landing pages and social media
- Offline sales: football matches and events in Japan; club sponsorship and partnership
- End-to-end: meetings, orders, fulfilment, after-sales support and upsell
- Daily stand-ups and quantitative and qualitative reporting in English for companies outside Japan

## Network

- Professional footballers
- Youth and academy footballers
- Development-age football clubs and schools
- Other people across the sports industry in Japan
